building.description: A building that groups floorplans together with vertical ordering and transformation capabilities

floorplan_name.description: Name of floorplan to which this access-point belongs.

building_name.description: Name of the building with which to look for floorplan_name

serial_number.description: Serial number of this access point.

mac_address.description: MAC Address of an access_point. Should be described in the format: 01:23:45:67:89:0a where it is 2 characters separated by colons and letters are lower case.

manufacturer.description: The manufacturer name for this access point.

model.description: The model number of this particular access point

sku.description: SKU part number for this specific access-point.

connected_switch.description: Information about the switch this access point is connected to

switch_name.description: Reference to the name of the switch this access point is connected to

port.description: The port on the switch that this access point is connected to

vlan.description: VLAN ID assigned to this access point connection

closet_name.description: Name or identifier of the closet where the connected switch is located

switch_id.description: vendor id of the switch which this access point is connected.

ssids.description: List of SSIDs available on this access-point

antennas.description: Array of antennas connected to this access-point.

orientation.description: If there are no antennas defined, or the antennas are integrated, the orientation for access-point should be used.

coordinates.description: Array of coordinate objects which contain both xyz and lat_long coordinate systems. This allows all objects to share multi-coordinate systems.

display_color.description: Hex color code for visualizing access points. Has no inherent intent, but for visualization purposes. Should start with "#" to indicate a hex color value. Example '#AC7400'

floorplan_name.description: Name of floorplan to which this switch belongs.

building_name.description: Name of the building with which to look for floorplan_name

manufacturer.description: The manufacturer name for this switch.

model.description: The model number of this particular switch

sku.description: SKU part number for this specific switch.

ip_address.description: Management IP address of the switch

closet_name.description: Name or identifier of the closet (Intermediate Distribution Frame) room/closet where this switch is located

coordinates.description: Array of coordinate objects which contain both xyz and lat_long coordinate systems.

display_color.description: Hex color code for visualizing the switch. Has no inherent intent, but for visualization purposes.

rack_units.description: number of rack units (RU) required for the device.

name.description: Unique name of floorplan (must be unique in the openintent payload.)

map_uri.description: URI where to retrieve the map. Not all URIs will be resolvable by all systems.

building_name.description: Name of the building with which to look for floorplan_name

floor_id.description: String representation of the floor id (Example: Ground, 1st, 3, etc)

rotation.description: Rotation of the floorplan from native orientation

attenuation_areas.description: List of areas on the floorplan

coverage_areas.description: List of coverage areas on the floorplan

holes_in_floor.description: List of areas on the floorplan

type.description: Type of network equipment closet (IDF=Intermediate Distribution Frame, MDF=Main Distribution Frame)

coordinates.description: Array of coordinate objects which contain both xyz and lat_long coordinate systems. This allows all objects to share multi-coordinate systems.

id.description: Radio id if one is known

channel_assignment.description: This defines if radios channels are manually assigned (human) or dynamically assigned by tooling.

secondary_channel.description: Secondary channel based on 802.11ac notation (center channel). Used with 80+80 and 160+160 channel width configurations to describe the secondary channel (not containing primary channel).

transmit_eirp.description: EIRP, requires antenna gain to calculate

mimo_chains.description: Number of radio chains this radio is operating with

leads.description: The number of leads an antenna has.

is_extended.description: Is the antenna extended with an RF extension cable?

unit_length.description: Unit for describing the length of the extension

length.description: Length of the extension in the unit_length

losses.description: Array of losses per frequency band.

antenna_type.description: Indicates if the antenna is classified as an omnidirectional or a directional antenna.

rf_connector.description: Details about RF connectors that would be present on an antenna or Accesspoint.

gender.description: Describes the gender of the RF connector

channel_width.description: Represents channel width configurations as a string

coordinate_xyz.description: A coordinate that references cartesian coordinates using x,y,z

x.description: Coordinate in X dimension represented as a number

y.description: Coordinate in Y dimension represented as a number

z.description: Coordinate in Z dimension as height from floor represented as a number

coordinate_lat_long.description: A coordinate that references geospatial coordinates using using lat/long and altitude

latitude.description: Latitude expressed as ISO 6709 in degrees

longitude.description: Longitude expressed as ISO 6709 in degrees

elevation.description: Height in meters above sea level

coordinate.description: A coordinate with both sets of x/y/z and lat/long

frequency_bands.description: Bands that an antenna or radio operates in.

orientation.description: Object that describes the orientation of an object. All descriptions can be referenced as a plane in flight.

rotation.description: Describes the rotation of the device in degrees where 0 is up on the floorplan orientation. For omnidirectional APs, if looking at the AP on the ceiling, the direction points toward the top of the vendor logo. For directional antennas/APs, the peak beamwidth should point in this direction. AKA yaw.

tilt.description: Describes the tilt of the device in degrees. For integrated antenna APs or omnidirectional antenna, 0 describes the default orientation. For directional APs, 0 describes the antenna as pointed horizontal, with positive values tilting up, and negative values pointing down. AKA pitch.

roll.description: Describes the rotation of the device in axis of rotation/tilt. 0 describes the devices default orientation. This will normally be zero in most scenarios. Would be used to rotate and antenna from vertical to horizontal polarization. AKA roll.

dimension.description: Dimension of a floorplan where the origin is located in the lower left corner, making all references to location positive values

unit.description: The dimension unit for length, width, height.

wall_segment.description: Represents a line segment of a wall on a floorplan. Each segment requires a start, and end and a description for the wall type.

wall_type.description: Name of wall type. Can be standalone or match a wall_material defined in main oi-wifi Preference is to define a wall type instead of specifying each value for each wall type.

display_color.description: Used if wall_material is not defined. Hex color code for visualizing access points. Has no inherent intent, but for visualization purposes. Should start with "#" to indicate a hex color value. Example '#AC7400'

thickness.description: Used if wall_material is not defined. Thickness in meters of the wall.

height.description: Used if wall_material is not defined. Height of the top of the wall from the floor.

bottom_height.description: Used if wall_material is not defined. If wall does not start at floor, define at what height from floor

wall_point.description: Two-dimensional coordinate of a wall point

reference_marker.description: A reference marker to denote a location on the floorplan. Can be used to provide notes, or a translation between coordinate systems.

name.description: Unique name of the reference marker.

material.description: Object that defines the properties of wall material

thickness_m.description: Thickness of the wall in meters. Do not fake wall thickness with arbitrary formulas. If wall thickness is not defined, omit and use flat attenuation values.

bottom_height.description: For walls, if the wall does not start at the floor, this allows you to specify the height the bottom of the wall is at.

top_height.description: For walls, the top_height is the height in meters of the top of the wall.

display_color.description: Used if wall_material is not defined. Hex color code for visualizing access points. Has no inherent intent, but for visualization purposes. Should start with "#" to indicate a hex color value. Example '#AC7400'

attenuation_flat.description: Flat attenuation value. Object attenuates this value dB regardless of thickness.

attenuation_per_m.description: Attenuation in dB per meter of thickness. Should multiply by thickness to calculate flat attenuation

area.description: An area is defined as a polygon with a list of coordinates. These coordinates must be colinear in order and the first and last must be colinear with each other.

exclusion.description: For exclusion areas, the flag would be true.

inverted.description: Inverted hole-in-floor objects are used to describe a hole that is everywhere but the defined area. Example would be If you wanted to show a building, but wanted a hole in floor for to indicate that exterior to the building was a hole. When not present, assumption is the value is false.

survey_wifi_adapter.description: A Wi-Fi adapter used by a survey device. Adapter provenance and RSSI calibration are important when comparing measurements collected by different platforms.

identifier.description: Identifier assigned to this adapter within the survey device.

regulatory_domain.description: Two-character regulatory domain code when known.

rssi_calibration_offset_db.description: Calibration offset in dB that was added to the adapter's reported RSSI values before they were stored in wifi_observation.rssi_dbm.

survey_device.description: Hardware and software provenance for a survey collection.

identifier.description: Identifier assigned to the device by the collecting system.

survey_data_resource.description: A payload associated with a survey path. Resources allow lossless raw captures and high-volume measurements to remain outside the OpenIntent document while preserving their role, integrity, and schema.

uri.description: Absolute or document-relative URI. Relative references are recommended for portable project archives.

media_type.description: IANA media type of the resource when known.

schema_uri.description: Schema describing a structured external resource. This is required for interoperable vendor-neutral structured data not defined by this OpenIntent schema.

sha256.description: Lowercase hexadecimal SHA-256 digest of the resource bytes.

wifi_security_mode.description: Security mode advertised by a BSS.

wifi_phy_type.description: IEEE 802.11 PHY type inferred or reported by the collector.

wifi_observation.description: One BSS observed during a scan event. RSSI is the value reported by the survey adapter after any declared calibration offset was applied.

observed_offset_us.description: Observation time in integer microseconds after survey_path.start_time. When absent, the parent scan_event time applies.

ap_mld_mac_address.description: Canonical lowercase AP MLD MAC address for an 802.11be MLO BSS.

ssid.description: Human-readable SSID when it has a lossless Unicode representation. An empty string represents a hidden SSID.

ssid_bytes_base64.description: Raw SSID bytes for values that cannot be represented losslessly as Unicode.

noise_dbm.description: Noise floor in dBm when reported by the collector.

snr_db.description: Signal-to-noise ratio in dB when reported by the collector.

frequency_mhz.description: Primary channel center frequency in MHz.

information_elements_base64.description: Concatenated raw 802.11 information elements when exposed by the collection platform. This preserves capabilities not normalized by the current schema.

scan_event.description: A scan result set collected at one time. Its position is either given directly by coordinate or derived from the survey path using its time.

id.description: Identifier unique within the OpenIntent document.

adapter_identifier.description: Identifier of the survey_device.wifi_adapters entry that produced this scan. It should be present when the device declares more than one adapter.

started_offset_us.description: Scan start in integer microseconds after survey_path.start_time.

result_status.description: Collector-reported completeness of the scan result set.

path_point.description: A point to be used along a path with reference to the data structure.

timestamp.description: Timestamp in Unix epoch format. Retained for compatibility; new producers should use survey_path.start_time with time_offset_us to avoid loss of sub-second precision in JSON numbers.

time_offset_us.description: Point time in integer microseconds after survey_path.start_time.

path_indicator.description: This indicates if the point is used to start a path segment, or end a path segment. Point type surveys should include both a START and a END with the same coordinate.  For middle points, this is not used.

survey_path.description: A time-referenced survey trajectory and its collected measurements. Measurements may be represented as interoperable inline scan events, external resources such as a PCAP/PCAPNG capture, or both.

id.description: Identifier unique within the OpenIntent document.

start_time.description: RFC 3339 timestamp used as the origin for integer time offsets.

path_data_uri.description: Legacy URI reference to path data. New producers should use data_resources, which supports roles, media types, and integrity.

collection_method.description: Primary method used to collect Wi-Fi observations.

survey_device_sw_version.description: Sofware version of the survey device.

survey_device_identifier.description: Unique identifier of the survey device

host_device_platform.description: platform of the host device. For example, if using a survey tool like a WLAN-PI, this field would describe the controlling device (e.g., "iPhone Pro Max 16").

path_type.description: To keep logic simple for implementers, we should specify if the points in this path are Point (stop and go) or a Continuous (line) type survey.

position_interpolation.description: Method used to derive scan-event coordinates from time-referenced path points. NONE means every scan event requiring a position must include its own coordinate.

path_points.description: Each path in the path points must have a START and END point. There can be multiple paths within the path_points, but each must contain a START and END point.  These points are ordered from start to end.

scan_events.description: Vendor-neutral Wi-Fi scan results collected on this path.

data_resources.description: External raw or high-volume data associated with this path.

offset_value.description: A distance value with unit, used for translation/offset operations.

value.description: The offset distance value (can be positive or negative)

floor_transform.description: 2D transformation parameters for positioning and orienting a floorplan within a building coordinate system. Transformations are applied in order: scale, then rotation, then translation (offset).

scale_x.description: Horizontal scale factor to apply to the floorplan. A value of 1.0 means no scaling. Values greater than 1.0 enlarge, values less than 1.0 shrink. Must be a positive number.

scale_y.description: Vertical scale factor to apply to the floorplan. A value of 1.0 means no scaling. Values greater than 1.0 enlarge, values less than 1.0 shrink. Must be a positive number.

rotation.description: Rotation in degrees to apply to the floorplan around its origin (lower-left corner). Positive values rotate counter-clockwise. This is applied after scaling and before translation.

x_offset.description: Horizontal (X-axis) offset to shift the floorplan. Applied after scaling and rotation. Positive values shift right.

y_offset.description: Vertical (Y-axis) offset to shift the floorplan. Applied after scaling and rotation. Positive values shift up.

building_floor.description: A floor within a building that references a floorplan and provides transformation parameters for positioning the floorplan within the building coordinate system.

floorplan_name.description: Reference to the name of a floorplan defined in the floorplans array. The floorplan must exist and its name must be unique.

floor_level.description: Integer representing the vertical position of this floor within the building. Higher values represent floors higher in the building. Floors are stacked top to bottom based on this value. Example: Ground floor = 0, First floor = 1, Basement = -1

floor_label.description: Human-readable label for the floor (e.g., "Ground", "Mezzanine", "Basement", "Roof"). Used for display purposes.

transform.description: 2D transformation parameters for positioning and orienting this floorplan within the building coordinate system.

building_address.description: Physical address information for a building. Uses international-friendly field names to support addresses worldwide.

address_lines.description: Flexible array of address lines (e.g., street address, suite number, building name). Supports any international address format.

locality.description: City, town, village, or equivalent locality name.

administrative_area.description: State, province, region, prefecture, or equivalent administrative division.

postal_code.description: Postal code, ZIP code, or equivalent.

country.description: Country name or ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code (e.g., "US", "JP", "DE"). ISO alpha-2 codes are recommended for interoperability.

building.description: Representation of a building that groups multiple floorplans together with vertical ordering and transformation capabilities.

name.description: Unique name of the building (must be unique in the openintent payload). This name is referenced by floorplan.building_name, accesspoint.building_name, and switch.building_name properties.

address.description: Physical address information for the building.

coordinates.description: Geospatial coordinate for the building location. Typically represents the building centroid position.

floors.description: Array of floor references with transformation properties. Floors are ordered top to bottom (highest floor_level is at the top of the building).
